words.engDef: the action of coming to live permanently in a foreign country
words.example: The government introduced new immigration laws to control the border.

words.engDef: about to happen; impending or fast approaching
words.example: They decided to evacuate the coastal village due to the imminent storm.

words.engDef: resistant to a particular infection or toxin, or exempt from duty
words.example: Vaccination helps the body build a strong immune system.

words.engDef: the action of one object coming forcibly into contact with another, or effect
words.example: The economic crisis has had a major impact on small businesses.

words.chinese: 極重要的，緊急的，必須的

words.example: It is imperative that we take quick action to reduce carbon emissions.

words.chinese: 帝國的，皇帝的，至高無上的

words.chinese: 暗示的，含蓄的，不言明而含有的

words.chinese: 壯觀的，宏偉的，令人難忘的

words.chinese: 冷漠的，漠不關心的，平庸的

words.chinese: 不可避免的，必然發生的

words.chinese: 較差的，次等的，下級的；下屬

words.chinese: 瘋狂的，愚蠢的，精神失常的

words.chinese: 完好無損的，未受觸動的
